question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Armed
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Armed"** means equipped with or carrying weapons. (सशस्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers were armed and ready for battle.
 
 
 
• **"Deprived" **refers to suffering a severe and damaging lack of basic material and cultural benefits; in the context of the opposite of armed, it means lacking weapons or arms. (वंचित)
 
 
• **Example: **The villagers were deprived of any means of defense.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Armed' **is **'Deprived'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delayed **(विलंबित): To make something late or slow.

 
 
• **Example:** The train was delayed due to bad weather.
 
 
 
• **Distorted **(विकृत): Pulled or twisted out of shape; contorted.
 
 
• **Example: **The image on the screen was distorted because of a technical glitch.
 
 
 
• **Denied** (अस्वीकृत): Refuse to give (something requested or desired) to (someone).
 
 
• **Example:** She was denied entry into the club.
 
 

38:Tbca,

The correct answer is: Option 3<
